Keeps repeated washing/body parts/death and hereditary duration without collapsing the warning.

Keeps intensified holiness and contact result aligned with 29:37, with alternative prerequisite reading noted.
Retains broad bodily-use prohibition alongside commanded priestly anointing, explains restricted-use context in note without deleting tension.
Keeps two offenses, outsider restriction and severe cut-off formula without equating it automatically with a specified mode of execution.
